data_sources.name: koppen_geiger_beck
data_sources.label: Beck et al. Köppen–Geiger maps
data_sources.producer_institution: Beck et al. author team; Figshare data repository
data_sources.description: Pinned Beck_KG_V1.zip, Figshare file 12407516, matching the current R adapter. The workbook also cites the scientifically distinct 2023 V2 release; that reference must not replace the V1 methods or future scenario. [Resource reconciliation: inventory rights and history] Inventory usage/citation statement (Amadeus data sources!I5): CC BY 4.0; cite Beck et al. (2018). Inventory source status (H5): Available (V1; superseded by V2, 2023); this is not observation QA, API availability or verified support for every product. Inventory first-release/history wording (J5): 2018. The adapter pins the Beck V1 archive. The separate 2023 reference describes V2 and does not change the V1 scenario, period or version. Static availability is not an annual update cadence.
data_sources.citation_apa: Beck, H. E., et al. (2018). Present and future Köppen–Geiger climate classification maps at 1-km resolution. Scientific Data, 5, 180214. https://doi.org/10.1038/sdata.2018.214

products.name: koppen_v1_present_0p0083
products.label: Köppen–Geiger V1 present, 0.0083 degree
products.description: Static classification and companion agreement maps summarizing 1980–2016. timeless follows the existing schema convention for static Köppen maps: no temporal_coverage dates are asserted. The climatological reference periods remain explicit here; this is not an annual observation series. 1980–2016 spans 37 years, despite the workbook generic 30-year wording. The 2018 V1 future map is RCP8.5, not the 2023 V2 ensemble. Nominal 0.0083/0.083 labels are rounded; exact spacings and dimensions come from all twelve TIFF headers. [Resource reconciliation: inventory completeness] Inventory coverage statement (Amadeus data sources!N5): Yes (global land). This statement does not establish validity of every cell/date or fill observation gaps.
products.spatial_extent_descriptor: Global land; rectangular geographic grid includes non-classified ocean cells

product_variables.harmonization_note: One unsigned 8-bit raster band in the named archive member. Native filename identifies the array; no extra named HDF/netCDF band is asserted. Class resampling must preserve labels (nearest/mode as appropriate); agreement percentages must not be processed as class codes.
